Meh game.

I was throughly unimpressed with Anderson. His passing, technique and movement was completely mediocre. I lost count of the number of times he struggled to get the ball out from under his feet. 

Hall was very lively and quick. Exactly what England needed on the left, he's like an energizer bunny up and down that flank.

If England want to bring a heading specialist to the world cup, make it a defender rather than a striker. I'm willing to sacrifice passing and technique from a defender but i'm not willing to sacrifice that in a striker. Solanke is a nothing. I'm strongly advocating Welbeck as Kane's backup. No matter what happens you're not going to replace Kane's goals but at the very least have a backup striker who has the strength and technique to hold the ball up, link up play and run hard.
